question_text: How are changes made to the U.S. Constitution?

why_it_matters.text: The Founders knew they wouldn't get everything right. So they built in a way to fix the Constitution — by adding amendments — but made it hard, so it changes only when almost the whole country agrees.

fun_fact.text: People have tried to change the Constitution more than 11,000 times. Only 27 of those changes ever made it in. It's that hard on purpose — so the rules change only when nearly everyone agrees.
